requirements.statement: Every criterion the Judge rules not met carries exactly one kind (build-defect, evidence-gap or not-checkable-here), returned by the Judge, recorded in verification-state.json, and shown in verification-report.md. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1; investigation Objectives O1

requirements.statement: Only build-defect criteria are handed to the Debug stage; an iteration with no build defect dispatches no Debug agent. Must pass: yes.

An evidence-gap criterion gets exactly one re-capture per run; if still an evidence gap it is settled with its reason, reported as a definition problem, and counts neither as open nor closed for the stalled and cap rules. Must pass: yes.

A not-checkable-here result is settled once with its reason and not re-opened by a later invocation (resume or /verify-build fix round) unless verification.md has changed since it was recorded; then the criterion re-opens. Must pass: yes.

Not-checkable results knowable before exercising (parts-only design board structure row; design-structure row on a production/minified environment) are classified at preflight, enter the run already settled not-checkable-here, and are never handed to Exercise. Must pass: not marked.
The setup check tolerates a dev server cold start: a warm-up request and a generous first-response timeout before a target's reach is recorded as failed. Must pass: not marked.

/verify-build fix rounds and /refine-verification read the recorded kind instead of re-deriving buildability from the cause, falling back to the cause only for a state file written before this change. Must pass: not marked.
One headless fixture run of /verify-build on a fixture seeded with one defect, one missing capture and one host-only criterion shows all three kinds in its report. Must pass: not marked (acceptance).
Tests pass; unit coverage at least 60% and integration coverage at least 50% where integration tests apply.
